orders: Perform a focused neurological examination of both lower limbs, including observed voluntary hip, knee, and ankle power, tone, patellar and Achilles reflexes, plantar responses, and sensory testing.
Perform Hoover’s sign and the hip-abduction test while the patient is distracted.
MRI of the brain with diffusion-weighted imaging and contrast.
MRI of the cervical and thoracic spinal cord with contrast.

Repeat a functional neurological examination during distraction, specifically Hoover’s sign, the hip-abduction sign, and observation of spontaneous use of the right arm and leg during transfers and walking.
Perform routine EEG with video monitoring.
served: deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses
video-EEG monitoring of a typical event
